subject: Request: latest penetration test summary & handoff plan
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@northbridge.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for latest penetration test & delivery options

Hi Jonas,

We are preparing for an executive security review next week and need the most recent penetration test report (hosted API scope) and a brief scope summary (what was and wasn't tested).

Can you indicate:
- The latest report date and scope (hosts, APIs, console, dedicated vs hosted)
- Any high-severity findings still open and the current remediation status
- Preferred secure transfer mechanisms (customer portal, SFTP, presigned URL, encrypted package) and any redaction steps you require

Our security team (security@northbridge.com) will also need a remediation-tracking CSV and a short README describing how to interpret the report. We may require an NDA before viewing sensitive detail; please advise.

Thanks — tight timeline on our side.

Tom Ellis
Head of Security Insights
Northbridge Financial
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@northbridge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-10-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test & delivery options

Tom — thanks for the heads up and the timeline. Happy to support. High level answers below and a proposed mutual action plan attached.

Quick answers:
- Latest completed test: 2026-09-14. Scope: Hosted API (public endpoints and control-plane console), authentication, token handling, and tenant isolation checks. Dedicated/Private customers were out of scope for that engagement; we can provide guidance if you need a dedicated-scope assessment.
- Severity: No open critical items. Two medium-severity items are in progress (rate-limiting hardening and an edge TLS config tweak). Expected remediation ETA: two sprint cycles (~3 weeks).
- Secure transfer options (preferred order): 1) Customer evidence portal (preferred: single-sign-on + audit logs), 2) short-lived SFTP account with scoped permissions, 3) password-encrypted ZIP delivered out-of-band, 4) presigned object link with strict TTL and one-time download.

What we need from you:
- Confirmation of recipient email(s) and whether an NDA is required before full disclosure
- Any internal redaction policy (PII/PCI/PHI rules) — we will default to redacting third-party PII and any customer-identifying data

Attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP-draft.csv) with timelines and owner fields. If that looks good we will:
1) Legal/security triage on our side for any NDA
2) Redaction pass (if required)
3) Upload redacted PDF and remediation matrix to the evidence portal and share an expiring link + access instructions

Would you like us to proceed directly with preparing the portal upload?

Thanks,

— Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- MAP-draft.csv (attachment)
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@northbridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: security@northbridge.com
Date: 2026-10-18T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test & delivery options

On 2026-10-18, Jonas Weber wrote:
> Attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP-draft.csv) with timelines and owner fields. If that looks good we will:
> 1) Legal/security triage on our side for any NDA
> 2) Redaction pass (if required)
> 3) Upload redacted PDF and remediation matrix to the evidence portal and share an expiring link + access instructions

Thanks Jonas — that plan works. A few clarifications:
- We will need the remediation_matrix as a CSV (columns: finding_id, severity, status, owner, target_date). That will be used by our SOC ops to track progress.
- NDA: preferred but not required for the initial redacted PDF. Our legal team will follow up if they need the unredacted package. For now, please proceed with a redacted copy.
- Access: portal is preferred. If you do portal, can you include SSO/SAML flow instructions; otherwise SFTP with short-lived creds is acceptable.
- Timeline: we need the redacted PDF + remediation CSV delivered by EOD Oct 20 (PST) if possible — otherwise earliest on Oct 21 is OK.

I'll loop in our security ops if they have questions.

Tom
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@northbridge.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-10-20T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request for latest penetration test & delivery options

Tom — looping from Product Security to confirm delivery. We completed the redaction pass and prepared the remediation matrix. Per your preference we've uploaded the files to our customer evidence portal and created an expiring access bundle.

What you will receive (attachments and portal):
- redacted_pt_summary_2026-10.pdf (PDF, redacted of vendor/customer identifiers)
- remediation_matrix_20261020.csv (CSV, finding_id, severity, status, owner, target_date)
- README_access_instructions.txt (short doc with SSO steps and token rotation notes)

Portal link (one-time/72h): https://portal.redwood-inference.com/share/expiring/xyz123?ttl=72h
Access notes:
- Use your corporate SSO (SAML). If SSO is not available, reply to this thread and we will issue an SFTP account for a 48h window.
- The portal records download events and will email notification for any redownloads.
- If you need the unredacted package for legal review, please have your legal/security contact send an NDA to legal@redwood-inference.com — we'll expedite.

I've attached the remediation matrix and the README to this email for quick offline review. The redacted PDF is available in the portal only (sensitive content withheld from outbound email).

If everything looks good I'll mark the MAP owner items as in-progress and update HubSpot (HS-32451) with the upload event.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Principal, Product Security
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com

Attachments:
- remediation_matrix_20261020.csv (attachment)
- README_access_instructions.txt (attachment)
